purpose: Define how a source family moves from dream to maintained public surface without skipping custody, privacy, synthetic, claim, and display gates.

rungs.name: Dream / telos only
rungs.description: A source family is named as possibility space only.

rungs.name: Source-family definition
rungs.description: The family is defined with risk, value, expected source owners, and first safe record kinds.

rungs.name: Source-owner and legal-access map
rungs.description: Access rules, source owners, publicness, and update cadence are mapped.

rungs.name: Carrier inventory
rungs.description: Public carriers can be listed without content claims.

rungs.name: Preservation/fixity queue
rungs.description: Targets can be queued for capture/hash/privacy.

rungs.name: Privacy and source-voice preflight
rungs.description: The family has review forms for vulnerable people, voice frames, and claim modalities.

rungs.name: Synthetic fixtures
rungs.description: Fictional cases test grammar and gates before live extraction.
rungs.allowed: synthetic evidence atoms and failure tests

rungs.name: Limited private live pilot
rungs.description: A tiny live pilot may be opened only with promotion receipts, privacy review, and rollback routes.

rungs.name: Public display candidate
rungs.description: A public display may be prepared after source custody, privacy, correction, and wording review.

rungs.name: Maintained public surface
rungs.description: Claims are public only with update, correction, rollback, and freshness obligations.
